items.title: Mask Detection System
items.description: Real-time face mask detection using computer vision.
items.details: This project implements a real-time face mask detection system using computer vision and deep learning. The system can detect whether people are wearing masks correctly, incorrectly, or not at all.

items.title: YouTube Interface Clone
items.description: Responsive UI clone focusing on layout accuracy.
items.details: A pixel-perfect responsive clone of YouTube's interface, demonstrating advanced CSS layout techniques including flexbox and grid. The project focuses on maintaining layout accuracy across different screen sizes.

items.title: Food Calorie Estimation
items.description: CNN-based calorie estimation from food images.
items.details: An AI-powered application that estimates calorie content from food images using convolutional neural networks. Built with TensorFlow and deployed using Streamlit for an interactive web interface.

items.title: Trip Itinerary Planner
items.description: A web-based travel itinerary planner that generates personalized trip plans based on destination, duration, and user preferences — focused on improving travel planning efficiency and user experience.
items.details: A comprehensive web-based travel itinerary planner built with Flask. The application generates personalized trip plans based on user preferences including destination, duration, budget, and interests, streamlining the travel planning process.
